Found 17 items in registries @akoder:

Showing items 1-17 of 17:

- ask-ai (registry:ui) - A popover prompt launcher with an animated mascot trigger, one-click query links for major AI providers, and instant clipboard fallback. [@akoder] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- model-picker (registry:ui) - A chat-style model switcher. Provider icons on a side rail filter the list to models available from that provider. [@akoder] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- command-palette (registry:ui) - A keyboard-first ⌘K palette with grouped actions, drill-down pages, recent items, and directional motion, built on cmdk inside a self-contained dialog shell. [@akoder] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- dotted-world-map (registry:ui) - A dependency-free SVG world map drawn with dots, tinted by heat value. Ships with interactive markers, tooltips, and a GitHub-style legend. [@akoder] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- copy-command-block (registry:ui) - A multi-package manager terminal command box with tab switcher (npm, pnpm, yarn, bun), persistent storage, copy feedback animation, and blueprint styling. [@akoder] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- github-map (registry:ui) - An interactive 52-week contribution activity graph with date-fns interval calculation, theme-aware level colors, and date tooltips. [@akoder] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- project-explorer (registry:ui) - An IDE-style project showcase with collapsible year folders, status badges, and floating cursor image hover previews. [@akoder] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- carousel (registry:ui) - Accessible touch-swipeable slide carousel with directional spring animations, keyboard arrow navigation, and pagination indicators. [@akoder] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- mode-toggler (registry:ui) - A minimal Sun / Moon theme toggle button built on next-themes. Supports an optional click sound, composable className, and dynamic aria-label. [@akoder] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- interactive-skill-cloud (registry:ui) - A draggable physics pill cloud powered by matter.js, pills rain down, pile at the bottom, and collide; grab one and fling it. [@akoder] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- contact-channels (registry:ui) - A hairline grid of contact cells with copy-to-clipboard actions, single-key shortcuts, tooltips, and blueprint hover styling. [@akoder] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- section-rail (registry:ui) - A responsive section navigation rail with scroll tracking, smooth anchor jumps, link mode, and optional rich hover previews. [@akoder] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- progress-bars (registry:ui) - A minimal textured bar chart with vertical and horizontal layouts, shipping a line fill and a dot matrix fill, driven by nothing more than a value per item. [@akoder] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- workflow-status (registry:ui) - Compact workflow badges with semantic defaults, custom states, icon and colour overrides, two sizes, and an icon-only form. [@akoder] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- glyph-card (registry:ui) - A hairline card whose background resolves into tiny plus marks on hover, gathering inside the glyph. Draws itself from a single SVG path on a 24x24 grid. [@akoder] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- snake (registry:ui) - A monochrome snake game on a dot-lattice field. Steer with the arrow keys, WASD, or a swipe, eat to grow by one segment, and wrap around the edges. [@akoder] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- stack-rolodex (registry:ui) - A rotating vertical pill stack that cycles through a list rolodex-style, with depth scaling, edge fading, and an optional side label. [@akoder] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`
